title: The order
description: A product's requirements and this order of it, in two sections, after the ARTI cube. `type` is the activity type's product side, a being the orderer authors: the product, the design version bound to it, the customer needs and the metrics after Ulrich & Eppinger (each metric a row of the requirements list after Pahl & Beitz), the product's objects as the owner sees them, each `fixed` or `free`, and the binding of the objects to a design version's features. `order` is the activity instance, a being over which the orderer and the requester agent decide: the brief (the order's intent), the mandate per metric, the owner's answering policy, the requirements in force and the accepted plan. A new order of the same product is a new version that changes only `order`. The schema holds the form; the checks (am_order/check.py) hold what a requirement as stated must be. `order-1.json` is the form before the two sections, read for the versions saved in it and migrated by `Order.from_v1`.

lineage.description: The product's id; it never changes. Names the type and every order of it

title.description: The product's title; it may change

parent.description: The product version this one was derived from

group.description: The id of the group the product stands in (groups.json)

revision.description: Set by the home on save

previous.description: The version saved before this one, by its hash; set by the home

saved.description: When the version was saved, ISO 8601 UTC; set by the home

type.description: The activity type, product side: the product's requirements as the orderer writes them (a being). The same for every order of the product

product.description: Activity type, product side: what the product is

purpose.description: What the product is for, in words

design.description: Activity type, product side: the design version the requirements are bound to, the design side's being, which the design engineer decides over

needs.description: Activity type, product side: the customer needs

objects.description: Activity type, product side: the product's objects as the owner sees them, each fixed (an interface the design keeps) or free (the design may change around it)

metrics.description: Activity type, product side: the requirements, each with its value, the limit and all the order asks

headings.description: Activity type, product side: per checklist heading with no metric, the owner's statement that nothing applies

bindings.description: Activity type, product side: the objects bound to the features of design versions

order.description: The activity instance: this order of the product (a being), over which the orderer and the requester agent decide, the agent within the mandates

brief.description: Activity instance: the order's intent. What may be relaxed is each metric's mandate; what may change in the design is said on the type's objects

text.description: The order in the orderer's words

objective.description: What matters most once the requirements are met (time, strength, mass, cost)

mandates.description: Activity instance: per metric id of the type, what the requester may accept without asking the owner. A metric without one is held

answering.description: Activity instance: the owner's answering policy, for a case the mandates do not cover: `park`, the case parks at the frame for the owner's word; `decline`, the requester declines the order on the evidence of exhausted means

in_force.description: Activity instance: the relaxations made in the run whose plan the orderer approved, by the requester agent within the mandates or by the owner beyond them, the requirements in force being the type's values with these applied. Written by the approval

accepted.description: Activity instance: the plan accepted for this order and approved by the orderer, null until one is. Written by the approval

group.description: The primary need it stands under

place.description: Where the object lies in the part's coordinates (mm): one region, or one per instance

change.description: Activity type, product side: `fixed`, an interface the design keeps; `free`, the design may change around it (the part free: its shape). Absent, fixed. The design level derives from the binding which of a design's parameters this frees

level.description: A metric's level: a number, three sizes, or a band

at.description: The object the load acts at

held_by.description: The objects that hold the part

datums.description: The objects the metric is referred to

mandate.description: Activity instance: what the owner delegates on one metric: `held`, the value stands; `interval`, the requester may accept up to the far end; `release`, the requester may give the metric up

to.description: The interval's far end: a value of the metric's form, or as_needed

carried_by.description: The objects that carry the metric

from.description: For matched: the earlier version's feature

rejected.description: Features the owner rejected for the object; never proposed again

relaxation.description: Activity instance: one relaxation made in a run, by the requester agent within the metric's mandate or by the owner, whom the mandate does not bound

what.description: The margin beneath a physical limit, or the value itself

showing.description: The dialogue's call of the showing it was made on

run.description: The frame's run it was made in

time.description: When the acceptance that made it was given

within_mandate.description: Whether the order's mandate on the metric covers it, as the frame judged it

accepted.description: Activity instance: the plan accepted for the order and approved by the orderer, with the order version placed and the design version it was made for

run.description: The frame's run that accepted it

order.description: The order version placed, whose run accepted the plan, by its hash as the frame names it

plan.description: The plan's id in the run's record

design.description: The design version the plan was made for

design_sha256.description: The design record's hash, as its feature list gives it
